architecture.scope: Static ecosystem portal with repository discovery, contract cataloguing and local browser labs backed by small Python tooling.
architecture.runtime_boundary: Browser UI and local Python CLI are separate execution contexts; portal metadata does not execute repository code.
architecture.composition_rule: Keep portal rendering, registry data, contract schemas and local planning logic in explicit modules with versioned JSON/C interfaces.

components.responsibility: Searchable repository catalogue and machine-readable manifests.
Versioned integration envelope and contract metadata.
Local dependency and integration path planning.
Local illustrative allocation, lifecycle and capability demonstrations.

preserved_boundaries: Static portal does not provide server-side authorization or a hosted database.
Browser labs use local/synthetic state unless an explicit adapter is introduced.
Repository registry entries are metadata, not executable plugin instructions.
forbidden_composition: No automatic checkout or execution of third-party repository code.
No presentation of sample data as live telemetry.
gaps: Add browser-level accessibility and interaction tests for the portal.
Keep portal metadata synchronized with reviewed federation contracts.
